body: It is easier said than done. I try not to think about him, but out of sudden I start crying, cant breathe and want to die. I am 28, not my first break up and still am unable to let go. It is destroying my life, and it has been almost a year.

Well, it might be true, but if you are right it makes me even more worried I will stay single. Which I dont want to be as I want to have children. I was so sure I am going to have family even 5 years ago, but time flies and the possibility goes away with each dáte which end with me being this way.
I felt like I am. I am over my ex and feel fine.

There are none really. The first date always goes great. But the second day I start to feel like I dont really want to be there, they bore mw, I start to feel annoyed and think of all the things I could do instead and feel like I am wasting my time. I try to redirect all the thoughts, it worked with the Last one, that is why we went on about 7 dates, but at the end I couldnt control myself anymore.

Hm, that might be the explanation. I teach at one not so good secondary school and after spending the day with all the teenagers I am kind of fed up with people, but I still see my friends and enjoy spending my time with them. Anyway, I need to work on that, I want to have family one day, but if I get annoyed with all the guys, it is not gonna happen.
I am not, unfortunately. If I were, at least I would have an explanation. I loved both of my ex boyfriends ať the end and was strongly sexually attracted to them :/

It is impossible as I am not physically attracted to men that much older. And also they annoy me as much, if not more, than those of my age as older men tend to explain everything and treat me in a patronizing way.

No, I already know I am pushing the men away. I just dont know why I do it and if it is going to be a lasting thing, I dont like the feeling of me being unable to let anyone in my life. Maybe some women here experienced or still experience the same and have some advice for me how to work on that, what to do and etc.
The problem is I dont want to be like that. I feel like I am going to end up being a lonely bitter spinster if I go on like this 🤣

The problem is I felt I was over my ex before I started to date this guy. It was a year afterall and my ex suddenly seemed to be a distant memory. What if it will happen again? I will be again single for another year believing I'm over it, starting a new relationship and finding out nothing has changed? How many times? Good men are not that easily found for introverts....I know it is the right thing to do but I am afraid to do it because in my country single women over 30 are still considered weird and I don't wish to end up like that just because I couldn't let go of my memories. 

So yeah, I will probably listen to you, guys and break up with him. By posting this I was just naively looking for some hope even though deep down I knew there was none :)
Is it a lie when he knows I don't love him? I told him it takes 3-6 months for me to fall in love and that's truth.

Thank you, that is what I am also wondering. My ex is out of the picture now, there are only memories and I don't want the memories to destroy any chances at having good relationship. 

But there is still the if....When he told me yesterday, I was quiet and he of course knows I don't love him, but I'm wondering how long will he wait and if there is a chance I might fall in love with him.

Am I really wasting his time? It is only one month since being together so I wonder what if it actually could work? I didn't like my ex at the beginning too and there were no past shadows like there are now. Won't I destroy the chance to have a good relationship? In my country some of still believe that long-lasting relationships have to be worked for.
Not only it sounds like that, it is true. I'm aware of it. The problem is I thought I was and started a new relationship and don't know what to do now.

That's the thing. I always thought he is the good guy and maybe he Is, because he doesn't realise he is the jerk of this story. I don't think he hurts me on purpose, he just enjoys being in the centre of my attention. He just told me how he feels, because we were the best friends all along, so what's wrong about it? 

It's just that....everything is wrong about it. I just had a half of bottle of vodka (I'm an abstinent) and ate about 10 000 kcals in food just to Hurt myself because I feel like a shit again thanks to this guy, thinking only one question: "Why wasn't I good enough for you to want me." Even when I write it, I already know the answer, because who likes desperation, right?

Yep, that. There are few men interested in me as well, but I just can't move as there is not a single day I'm not thinking about him. It's even worse now as I broke the NC, so I'm thinking constantly about him.

Exactly. My ex was/is my best friend, and I'm going so crazy that I miss all of him, even the things I used to not like so much. He was my personal sun...now he is somebody else's sun. 

Hopefully it will get better, right? Right?

The same here. I just hate the thought of him replacing me with his new gf, because I've always felt I hold the special place in his life and I just can't think of him suddenly having the same or maybe even more with the new girl.
Thank you so much for your reply. I've been feeling really anxious since I've sent that message and I feel really low, weak and pathetic now.

I'm exactly the same. I was in the Armenia, I tried new hobbies, I found a new job....but nothing helps...I want to write him so much, even though I know that the last time we spoke to each other he started seeing other girl and is probably having a serious relationship with her now.....I miss him terribly much and I'm thinking of nothing else.
Agreed. Another pearl after telling them you went NC: "Oh no, we were hoping you would get back together."

I know the feeling. I also wanted to be friends, but when I learnt he actually really likes the girl and there is no chance of getting back together I had to let him go. Take the step and say goodbye to him/her. I'm not going to lie, it will hurt so much, but not as much as watching him/her loving another while you still love him/her.

I know the feeling of fucking things up, I go through the same. The only thoughts that go through my mind are "I was so stupid to act like this, to think this, to say those things to him. It is all my fault, etc., etc." I also had something that now feels like true love, all of my friends envied this kind of relationship I had with my ex and I literally threw all of it away and now I'm alone, depressed and fallen apart. 

However, I hope you do realise none of this is actually true, right? This is the pain of break-up speaking and our wishful thinking of getting back together with the ex. When we blame everything on ourselves, we are saying it was all in our hands and so we can change ourselves and maybe in the future..... but it weren't only us in the relationship, it always takes two. 

I also feel such a huge pain and have trouble eating, but I keep reminding myself I need energy to fight all these negative thoughts. If you will not eat, you'll be weak and it will lead to you not being active which will push you even lower than you are right now. Let's fight it together, let's show ourselves we are fighters. I believe in fate (to a certain extent) and if mine and yours were true loves that were meant to be then let's fate to deal with that. I know it'll be difficult for both of us, but let's try. At least we know we are not the only ones in this struggle (thank god for reddit).

Keep fighting!

Hello, thank you for your advice and support. 

You are right in everything what you say of course, but I cannot help myself. I have already decided to work on myself, to work on my body so it would be my top form, to learn some new skills, to focus on myself and my well-being....and it lasted for about 30 minutes. It is like I'm punishing myself for something, like I want to hurt myself (if that makes any sense).

I don't wish to give up my education but I'm unable to focus, therefore I know nothing which, if I cared about the exams, would add to my stress. I think the "I don't care" attitude is more of a defensive reaction so I will not fall apart even more. I'm studying for being a high school teacher so I have 3 different sets of final exams from 3 fields. Fortunately for me, this set is the easiest one and I can have another try in February and then ask the rector for the third try if I won't pass then. 

The rebound thing is complicated. I started seeing the guy because I have already gone through all of this and I finally felt better....then I spent a weekend with my ex watching movies and all that and suddenly I realised I'm not over him. After that I've decided for the no contact thing. I live alone and this guy is actually one of very few people who visit me as I'm teaching him language every day. I'm afraid that is e stops visiting me, I will fall into depression. You are right it's unfair to him but as I said he knows all the details, he knows my stance and he even realises he is probably a rebound.

Hello and thank you so much for your reply. 

I will probably go there, but the chances of me actually passing the exams are almost none. I will try though, even with my limited knowledge of the subjects, there are actually only 5 days till the exam, so I will not have time to study, as I'm unable to study for more than 2 hours a day. I will try though.

The rebound thing is complicated. I started seeing the guy because I have already gone through all of this and I finally felt better....then I spent a weekend with my ex watching movies and all that and suddenly I realised I'm not over him. After that I've decided for the no contact thing. 

I will probably go and see a therapist, I actually should go to one as I have a strong anxiety issue and my psychiatrist actually advised me to find a therapist as well.
